article.intro: The team name is the first answer the quizmaster reads out, so make it a good one. This **quiz team name generator** gives funny pub quiz and trivia team names, with quiz in the name or themed on music, film, sport, history, work or family, for a pair, a four or a whole table.

faqs.question: What are some funny quiz team names with quiz in the title?
faqs.answer: Swap "quiz" into a phrase everyone knows: Quiz Pro Quo, Quizzing the Point, Quiztakes Were Made or Quizzly Bears. Choose Quiz in the name for more like these.

faqs.question: What is a good quiz team name for 2 people?
faqs.answer: Play on there being two of you: Better Halves, Two Clever by Half or One Pen Between Us. Choose Two of us under Team size, and add a theme if your quiz has one.
